```{r setup-mascot_preview, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

```{r mascot_preview-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_preview")
```

### Offline comparison

mascot_preview() draws your character offline across light and dark modes, comparing your chosen size
with 160, 96 and 24 px columns. Previews are always inline and accept no placement or click arguments.

```{r mascot_preview-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_preview", studio_character)
```
